items.text: Cristian Morales works as vice president of operations at Industrial Electronic Engineers, a role he has held since 2022, and his biography lists a bachelor’s degree from Purdue University and a master’s from Cornell University.

sentences.text: Cristian Morales works as vice president of operations at Industrial Electronic Engineers, a role he has held since 2022, and his biography lists a bachelor’s degree from Purdue University and a master’s from Cornell University.

items.text: Morales names jobs, housing, and safety as the district’s top three issues. He supports tax cuts and reduced government spending, and has criticized state policies that he says make California expensive for businesses. In a 2026 voter guide questionnaire, he opposed government funding for abortion providers, including Planned Parenthood, and supported eliminating the U.S. Department of Education. On health care, he says the Affordable Care Act failed to provide affordability and emphasizes preventive care. On immigration, he advocates for a specific policy for immigrants and asylum seekers from Mexico and Northern Triangle countries.
